assets.title: Fixed Double-wing Flag Panel
assets.description: One original fixed three-panel photographic flag visual prop. A broad central solid thick rectangle and two narrow solid thick side wings are set at fixed 35 degree angles, with genuine open fold seams. Each side has two complete thick square-bored fixed and wing ears, a separate whole headed square pin with radial air and visible lower end clearance, and two finite solid angle stops. Complete opposed finite hinge shoulder and stop faces support the wings; none is a floating thin plane. A full rear saddle, offset straight mast, hexagonal hub and three independent low radial legs with full flat soles complete one static prop. Twenty-five editable closed connected meshes and four opaque constant unlinked Principled PBR materials, metre units, native Z up, front -Y and horizontal bounds-centred ground origin. Newly authored panel, pierced-ear, fixed-stop and three-foot geometry; no old reflector, softbox, backdrop, divider or scene geometry is imported or evaluated. No textures, graphics, text, logo, fabric, animation, folding, angle adjustment or height adjustment. No light-blocking, absorption, reflectance, optical control, wind resistance, loading, clamping, compatibility, stability, material, manufacturing or safety performance claim.
